title: Callvale before: DNS at the registrar
claim: The registrar's DNS answers callvale.example with the address of one old instance, so users do not reach CloudFront or the load balancer.
alt: Before: users on the left ask the registrar's DNS for callvale.example and get the IP address of one old instance. CloudFront and the Application Load Balancer stand on the right with no name that points to them.

edges.label: its address
edges.say: The registrar's DNS answers with the address of one old instance.
CloudFront and the load balancer are ready, but no name points to them.
